mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals worsening supply conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the core CPI above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% signals a slowing economy that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where quarterly GDP growth is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 100,000 indicates weak labor market performance, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where non-farm payrolls growth is below 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105 for two consecutive months signals strong manufacturing activity that forecasts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 105 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
